build_taskmaster3_dataset: build the taskmaster-3 dataset by downloading all 20 data files and the ontology API JSON
run_build_function: run the build function with an opt dict containing a datapath key to download taskmaster-3 data
download_taskmaster3_resources: download the taskmaster-3 resources list of downloadable files to a specified directory path
check_taskmaster3_built: check if the taskmaster-3 dataset has already been built at the given version string
review_downloadablefile_resources: review the RESOURCES list of DownloadableFile objects with URLs, filenames, and SHA256 hashes
